record.dic_text:
08110 Shimrown {shim-rone'}

源自 08105 其原意;

AV - Shimron 5; 5

伸崙 = "守望高處"
陽性專有名詞
1) 以薩迦的第四個兒子, 和伸崙族的祖先
專有地名詞 
2) 迦南王屬城被分配給西布倫
record.edic_text:
08110 Shimrown {shim-rone'}

from 08105 in its original sense;

AV - Shimron 5; 5

Shimron = "watch-height"
n pr m
1) 4th son of Issachar and the progenitor of the family of Shimronites
n pr loc
2) a Canaanite royal city allotted to Zebulun
